description: Source code for the VideoDecodeAccelerator class in the media namespace, implementing video decoding functionalities, including configuration, client interactions, and capabilities.

classes.name: VideoDecodeAccelerator
classes.description: Class handling video decoding acceleration, including configuration, decoding, buffer management, and capabilities.

classes.name: VideoDecodeAccelerator::Config
classes.description: Configuration settings for the video decode accelerator, including profile and encryption status.

classes.name: VideoDecodeAccelerator::Client
classes.description: Interface for clients interacting with the video decode accelerator, handling initialization, picture buffers, and overlays.

classes.name: VideoDecodeAccelerator::SupportedProfile
classes.description: Describes supported video profiles with resolution ranges and encryption info.

classes.name: VideoDecodeAccelerator::Capabilities
classes.description: Describes the capabilities of the video decode accelerator, including supported profiles.

methods.name: AsHumanReadableString
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string describing the configuration or capabilities.

methods.name: NotifyInitializationComplete
methods.description: Notifies that initialization is complete; default implementation indicates not supported.

methods.name: ProvidePictureBuffersWithVisibleRect
methods.description: Provides picture buffers with specified visible rectangle, handling texture target specifics.

methods.name: GetSharedImageStub
methods.description: Returns shared image stub; default is nullptr.

methods.name: GetCommandBufferHelper
methods.description: Returns command buffer helper; default is nullptr.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Decodes a buffer; default implementation indicates not supported.

methods.name: TryToSetupDecodeOnSeparateSequence
methods.description: Attempts to set up decoding on a separate sequence; must be overridden.

methods.name: ImportBufferForPicture
methods.description: Imports a buffer for a picture; default indicates not supported.

methods.name: SetOverlayInfo
methods.description: Sets overlay information; default indicates not supported.

methods.name: GetSurfaceInternalFormat
methods.description: Returns the internal format of the surface, default GL_RGBA.

methods.name: SupportsSharedImagePictureBuffers
methods.description: Indicates support for shared image picture buffers; default false.

methods.name: GetSharedImageTextureAllocationMode
